house.description: Temporary nursing facility rate increase established.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Human Services Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to human services; establishing a temporary nursing facility rate increase.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+NURSING FACILITY TEMPORARY RATE ADD-ON. +]

[+Effective July 1, 2025, the commissioner of human services shall provide a temporary rate add-on for nursing facilities reimbursed under Minnesota Statutes, chapter 256R, in an amount equal to $12.35 per resident day. The rate add-on under this section shall expire June 30, 2026. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective July 1, 2025, or upon federal approval, whichever is later. The commissioner of human services shall notify the revisor of statutes when federal approval is obtained. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to human services; establishing a temporary nursing facility rate increase.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. NURSING FACILITY TEMPORARY RATE ADD-ON.

Effective July 1, 2025, the commissioner of human services shall provide a temporary rate add-on for nursing facilities reimbursed under Minnesota Statutes, chapter 256R, in an amount equal to $12.35 per resident day. The rate add-on under this section shall expire June 30, 2026.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective July 1, 2025, or upon federal approval, whichever is later. The commissioner of human services shall notify the revisor of statutes when federal approval is obtained.

This section is effective July 1, 2025, or upon federal approval, whichever is later. The commissioner of human services shall notify the revisor of statutes when federal approval is obtained.
